evaluation.overall_comment:
The translation accurately captures the scientific content and maintains an appropriate educational tone, with particularly strong handling of quantum mechanics and optics terminology. However, a critical formatting defect—repeated speaker names at the beginning of nearly every line—severely disrupts readability and professional polish. A few minor phrasing choices (e.g., `「保存」さ` instead of `保存則`) also require correction. With structural cleanup and terminology fine-tuning, this would be a high-quality, publication-ready translation. As is, it sits in the mid-range due to presentation flaws despite solid technical accuracy.
